uncited: **Read Image:** Load the volume file into an image structure.
**Create Digital Set:** Initialize a digital set and populate it with voxels satisfying the threshold criteria.
**Initialize Khalimsky Space:** Construct the Khalimsky space from the image domain.
**Define Surfel Adjacency:** Initialize the adjacency object.
**Extract Boundary Surfels:** Scan the space to identify the boundary surfels.
**Initialize Embedder:** Create an embedder to map digital cells to real coordinates.
**Convert to Mesh:** Convert the digital surface to a dual polygonal or triangulated surface.
**Finalize Mesh:** Convert the polygonal/triangulated surface to a viewable mesh format.
- **Time Complexity:** The boundary extraction step (`sMakeBoundary`) dominates the runtime.
- **Memory Complexity:** Depends on the number of surfels and the size of the Khalimsky space.
